def: properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) put to death

occurrences.text: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
